name: teika-language
description: Teika language support backed by the OCaml language server.

scripts.build: direnv exec "$PWD/../.." dune build --root "$PWD/../.." --build-dir "$PWD/../_build" @lsp/vscode-extension lsp/demo_lsp.exe && mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/vscode_extension.js && NODE_PATH=node_modules esbuild ../_build/default/lsp/vscode_extension/lsp/vscode_extension.js --bundle --platform=node --external:vscode --outfile=dist/vscode_extension.js
